description: Comprehensive tests for the publishStore and PublishWorkflow UI components. Tests cover the workflow state machine, validation logic, and component rendering/interaction.
steps: Create src/stores/__tests__/publishStore.test.ts following the pattern in bomStore.test.ts. Mock @/lib/supabase. Tests: (1) initial state is correct, (2) runValidation detects missing SKU assignments (set projectStore with zones but empty zoneSku map), (3) runValidation detects zone overlaps (set overlapping zones in projectStore), (4) runValidation detects zone boundary violations, (5) runValidation detects missing metadata, (6) runValidation passes when all gates pass, (7) generateMasterBom inserts and fetches BOM data, (8) approveMasterBom updates status, (9) publishTemplate updates template status, (10) publishTemplate handles DB trigger error, (11) reset returns to initial state.

Create src/components/PublishWorkflow/__tests__/PublishWorkflow.test.tsx following the pattern in BomPanel/__tests__/BomPanel.test.tsx. Mock @/lib/supabase. Tests: (1) does not render when currentStep is IDLE, (2) renders panel when workflow is active, (3) StepIndicator shows correct active step, (4) ValidationResultsPanel shows pass/fail results, (5) Generate BOM button appears only when all validations pass, (6) ApprovalStep shows BOM lines and Approve button, (7) PublishConfirmation shows Publish button, (8) close button resets state, (9) Publish Template button in Toolbar only visible for DESIGNER + DRAFT, (10) error state displayed when publish fails.
Verify all new and existing tests pass together.
acceptance_criteria: publishStore.test.ts has at least 10 test cases covering all actions and error paths
PublishWorkflow.test.tsx has at least 8 test cases covering rendering and interactions
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
